instructions: Before writing UI, find what exists. Web (PHP, CSS, JS): suggest_component names the ws_* helper and its options, list_tokens the token for a role.

Native (Swift): native_apps gives an app's theme files, build and screenshot commands; list_tokens with platform "swift" and app gives each token as Color(hex:) and the theme constant that already mirrors it. Swift values live only in the app's theme files.

After writing, check: validate_file on every changed .php, .css, .js or .swift file, or check_snippet with code and language (css, php, js or swift; for Swift pass file_path so it knows the app and whether the file is a theme file). npm run lint:ds:native checks every native app against its baseline.
No check sees accessible names, roles, focus order or target size (44pt): read the rendered accessibility tree. Of Dynamic Type, native-fixed-font catches fixed text sizes only.

tools.list_tokens: List design tokens from platform-tokens.css with their purpose, tier (brand | semantic | primitive | alias) and, for a legacy alias, the --brand* token to use instead. Filter by category, or pass a plain-language role (e.g. "red text on light" gives --brand-ink). With platform "swift", each token is shown as Swift (Color(hex: 0xRRGGBB)) beside the native app constants that mirror it, drifted ones marked; add app to see one app, and with app and no filter its off-system constants too.
tools.suggest_component: Given a description of what UI element you need, suggest which ws_* component to use, ranked from the generated catalog (summary, when-to-use, synonyms). Each suggestion carries option values and defaults from the catalog, the legacy lookalike to avoid, the alternatives to choose instead and when (insteadOf), and a playground preview URL, labelled curated (a hand-written fixture) or auto (built from the catalog entry). E.g., "a confirm dialog before deleting a workshop" → ws_modal. A request whose head noun is a page, screen or flow also gets the matching screen recipe, a runnable file with default, loading, empty and error previews, first when it outscores the components, e.g. "a page listing workshops with filters" → recipe:filtered-workshop-list.
tools.check_snippet.file_path: Optional, for Swift: the project-relative or absolute path the snippet belongs in, e.g. library-app/WorkshoprLibrary/Screens/Home/HomeView.swift
tools.consult_ui.file: Project-relative path of the file you are about to change, e.g. app/views/team.php
tools.record_case.file: Project-relative path of the file the markup is in, e.g. app/views/team.php
tools.scan_components.paths: Optional project-relative files or folders to scan instead of the whole codebase, e.g. ["admin/analytics"]

text.componentsFooter:
From `/design-system/components.generated.json` (components in helpers.php, page-level in includes/components/*.php, app-local in app/includes/workshop-list.php).
CSS in `/includes/components/components.css`.
Demos at `/design-system/component-library.php`.
text.noComponent: You may need to create a new component. Add it as a ws_* function in /includes/components/helpers.php with a demo in /design-system/components/.
text.noColorToken: No matching token found: add to platform-tokens.css or use existing semantic token
text.spacingOffScale: Use nearest token from spacing scale (4px base)

native.pureBlack: Pure black text violates the design rules
native.font: Use Fraunces for headlines or Inter for text (icons: {iconFonts}), through the theme's font helpers
native.systemFont: Use the theme's Fraunces or Inter helper; .system(size:) is for sizing an SF Symbol image

staged.hint: A component for what you built: npm run ds:find -- "<what it is>".
staged.noPhp: note: php not found, so the page, drift and catalog checks were skipped (CI still runs them).

pureBlack.message: Pure black (#000) violates design rules: use warm neutrals
pureBlack.suggestion: Use var(--color-ink) (#2C2416) for text, var(--gray-900) for darkest bg

pureWhite.message: Pure white background violates design rules: use warm off-whites
